subject: Emergency: unexpected overrun during launch - request for short-term headroom and invoice adjustment
messages:
From: Evelyn Soto <evelyn@arborlabs.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@arborlabs.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected overrun during launch — urgent support request

Hi Jonas / Laura,

We pushed a paid acquisition campaign at 03:00 PDT this morning and saw a sharp spike in inference volume. Your dashboard shows an overrun of ~4.8M tokens in a 2-hour window and an associated invoice holdback that will exceed our projected spend for May. We expected a small headroom but not this magnitude.

Can Redwood provide a temporary headroom or a short-term cap so our service doesn’t degrade while we throttle back? Specifically: 
- A 48–72 hour temporary increase to our throughput or a grace headroom for the surge period
- A credit or true-up for the unexpected burst, as this was a one-off from a marketing trigger

I’ve attached the usage CSV and our launch notes. Procurement is on the CC for PO adjustments if needed. We’d like to resolve without a billing dispute.

Thanks,
Evelyn Soto
Head of Ops, Arbor Labs

Attachment: arbor_usage_report_launch_20250504.csv (CSV, 120KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Soto <evelyn@arborlabs.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected overrun during launch — urgent support request

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the heads up and for sending the CSV. I’m glad you flagged this before it impacted response quality. Short answer: we can help bridge this.

Proposal (short-term):
- Immediate: open a temporary headroom of 50% above your current committed QPS for the next 48 hours to let you finish the campaign without throttling.
- Billing: we’ll apply a provisional blended overrun rate for that window and hold final settlement pending a quick review. If this is a one-off, we will propose a one-time credit (TBD, typically 10–30% depending on volume and contract) and true-up the remainder to standard PAYG.
- Next steps: I’ll loop Finance/Legal for approval and send you a formal amendment for signature. If Procurement prefers a PO route we can accept that as well.

Action items: 
1) Ben / Laura — can you confirm whether we can apply a 48h headroom and a provisional blended rate while Legal drafts a short amendment?
2) Evelyn — if you can confirm the exact window you want the headroom to cover (start time for the 48h), I’ll put the change in place immediately.

On it now.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

--

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Soto <evelyn@arborlabs.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected overrun during launch — urgent support request

Jonas / Laura / Evelyn — quick finance/legal take from our side: 

We can approve a 48-hour emergency headroom while we prepare a short amendment. Suggested guardrails: 
- Temporary headroom: +50% QPS/throughput for 48 hours starting at the window Evelyn confirms.
- Provisional billing: apply a provisional blended rate (paygo + 15% surcharge) for the headroom period to avoid invoice shock.
- Credit: offer a onetime retroactive credit equal to 20% of the overrun tokens billed during that window if Arbor confirms this was a controlled launch and not recurring.

Operationally we need:
1) A signed short-form amendment or DocuSign envelope capturing the headroom window, billing treatment, and PO number if Procurement will push payment. I’ve attached a first-pass amendment PDF (proposed_bridge_amendment_v1.pdf).
2) A HubSpot note recording the concession (link below) and a finance ticket to mark the invoice as provisional until final true-up.

Legal flagged two small items: explicit end date for the headroom, and confirmation that any additional sustained growth should be handled under the standard commit conversion process. Otherwise we’re good to move quickly.

Links: HubSpot deal note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/7890
DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/secure/envelope/ABCDEF123456

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_bridge_amendment_v1.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Soto <evelyn@arborlabs.ai>, Procurement <procurement@arborlabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected overrun during launch — emergency headroom confirmed

Evelyn — thanks, and confirmed. We’ve put the temporary headroom in place starting 03:00 PDT on 2025-05-04 for 48 hours as requested.

Summary of what will happen next: 
- Headroom: +50% QPS for 48h (started 2025-05-04 03:00 PDT, ends 2025-05-06 03:00 PDT).
- Billing: provisional blended rate applied for that window; final invoice will be marked provisional and held for a true-up.
- Credit: finance has proposed a 20% one-time credit on the billed overrun for that window pending your confirmation this was a single launch.
- Paperwork: please review and sign the amendment in DocuSign (link below). If Procurement will issue a PO instead, forward it to laura_bennett@redwood.ai and we’ll attach it to the amendment.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/secure/envelope/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/7890

If all good I’ll close this thread and mark the deal note accordingly. Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
